meta.name: demo-prep
meta.description: Prepare a customer demo or executive walkthrough around an evidenced outcome. Use before show-and-tell to rehearse the journey and prepare a fallback.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把客户演示提前完整走一遍,练熟流程并备好兜底方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果马上要在客户或高管面前现场演示,想先彩排并想好备用方案。
copy.tagline_en: Rehearse a customer demo end to end and have a fallback ready.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must demo live to a customer or exec and want to rehearse first.

howto.what: 帮你围绕一个有证据支撑的成果安排客户演示或高管走查,演示前排练整条流程,并准备一套备用方案。
howto.when: 在你准备客户演示或高管走查、即将做展示汇报之前触发,用来排练流程和准备备用方案。

say.text: 帮我为下周的客户演示准备流程
say.note: 围绕有证据的成果排练演示路径

say.text: 给这次高管走查准备一个备用方案
say.note: 在主流程之外补一份回退方案

say.text: 用这个已交付的成果排练一遍演示
say.note: 按成果顺序过一遍演示旅程

howto.what_en: Claude prepares a customer demo or executive walkthrough built around an evidenced outcome, rehearses the journey beforehand, and prepares a fallback.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a customer demo or executive walkthrough, i.e. before show-and-tell, to rehearse the journey and prepare a fallback.

say_en.text: Help me prepare the demo flow for next week's customer demo
say_en.note: Rehearses the journey around an evidenced outcome

say_en.text: Prepare a fallback for this executive walkthrough
say_en.note: Adds a fallback plan alongside the main path

say_en.text: Rehearse this demo with me using the delivered outcome
say_en.note: Walks the demo path in outcome order
